description: Minimal capability set for the shell. Permissions are added per feature, never broadened preemptively (docs/SECURITY.md §2). dialog:allow-open is Code Health's project-folder picker and the manual Browse… path; dialog:allow-save is Save report. BOTH ONLY ASK FOR A PATH — no fs permission is granted, so the webview cannot read or write a single file. Save report hands its path to a Rust command that writes the two files, because a general fs:allow-write-text-file would be a write-anywhere primitive in the webview of a tool that already runs subprocesses against the user's interpreters.
